PROP-e5782b58-inv-016.text: Members.users.id must reference auth.users(id) from Discord OAuth; no orphaned member records.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-016.assertion: forall m in members.users: EXISTS(auth.users WHERE id = m.id)

locations.note: Inserts supabase_auth_user_id: user.id (line 285) where user comes exclusively from supabase.auth.getUser() (line 238). The FK relationship is enforced by inserting only authenticated users' IDs. No anonymous or fabricated IDs can be inserted.
User-context client validates session via Supabase auth, ensuring user.id always refers to a real auth.users record.
